faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.sub: Everything you need to know about DokanDari
faq.q1: Does the customer have to pay the ৳5 fee?
faq.a1: No, never! Customers order completely free of charge. The ৳5 fee is only a platform service fee billed to the seller per completed order.
faq.q2: What if I get zero orders in a month?
faq.a2: You pay ৳0! There are no monthly subscriptions or hidden charges. You are only charged when an actual customer order is created.
faq.q3: What happens if an order is fake or cancelled?
faq.a3: When a seller marks an order as 'Fake/Cancelled', the ৳5 fee is immediately credited back (reversed) to the seller's ledger.
faq.q4: What happens when unpaid dues reach ৳500?
faq.a4: If unpaid dues reach ৳500 (100 orders), new incoming customer orders are temporarily paused until settled via bKash or Nagad.

billingPolicy.title: Billing & Payment Policy (৳5 per order)
billingPolicy.s1Body: DokanDari has no monthly subscription fees, setup fees, or hidden charges. A ৳5 platform service fee is billed only when a seller receives a successful customer order.
billingPolicy.s1Example: 💡 Example: 10 orders a month = ৳50 bill. 100 orders = ৳500. Zero orders in a month = exactly ৳0 bill!
billingPolicy.s2Body: Customers never pay any service charge or platform fee. They only pay for the product price and delivery charge. The ৳5 fee is an internal seller service charge.
billingPolicy.s3Title: 3. Fee Reversal on Fake / Cancelled Orders
billingPolicy.s3Body: Online commerce carries the risk of fake or cancelled orders. DokanDari is committed to protecting seller finances:
billingPolicy.s3Point1: If an order is confirmed fake or cancelled before delivery, marking it cancelled on the dashboard immediately reverses (refunds) the ৳5 fee.
billingPolicy.s3Point2: Delivered or completed orders are not eligible for fee reversals.
billingPolicy.s4Body: Sellers can view their total due anytime in the dashboard billing section and settle easily via bKash or Nagad.
billingPolicy.s4Warning: ⚠️ Due Cap Rule: When unpaid dues reach ৳500 (100 unpaid orders), incoming orders pause temporarily until settled via bKash or Nagad.
billingPolicy.s5Body: All fee and reversal transactions are recorded in an immutable ledger in the database with complete transparency and zero hidden adjustments.

termsPolicy.title: Terms of Service
termsPolicy.s1Body: DokanDari is a software tool providing direct order collection and storefront interfaces for online sellers. All product deliveries and payments occur directly between customer and seller.
termsPolicy.s2Body: Sellers are solely responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their phone number and 4-digit PIN.
termsPolicy.s3Body: Selling illegal, counterfeit, or prohibited goods under Bangladesh law is strictly prohibited. Violating stores will be suspended immediately.
termsPolicy.s4Body: A fee of ৳5 is levied per successful order as described in our billing policy.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.s1Body: Customer contact and delivery information is used strictly to fulfill seller orders. DokanDari never sells customer data to third parties.
privacyPolicy.s2Body: Last delivery address is saved locally in customer browser storage for fast repeat checkouts.
privacyPolicy.s3Body: All communication is secured using industry-standard HTTPS/TLS encryption. PINs are stored as cryptographic one-way hashes.
privacyPolicy.s4Body: For questions regarding our privacy policy, contact our WhatsApp support.
